html:
G'oya

Ikki bosqich: avval har bir shahar bo'yicha buyurtmalarni sanaymiz, keyin shu natijadan eng katta sonni olib, unga teng shaharlarni qoldiramiz. Birinchi bosqich CTE'ga chiqariladi, chunki u ikki joyda kerak: natija uchun ham, MAX uchun ham.

Yechim

WITH city_orders AS (
  SELECT c.city, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.city
)
SELECT city, order_count
FROM city_orders
WHERE order_count = (SELECT MAX(order_count) FROM city_orders)

Buyurtmalar bo'lmasa, city_orders bo'sh, MAX esa NULL qaytaradi. order_count = NULL hech qachon rost emas, natija o'z-o'zidan bo'sh chiqadi.

Tuzoqlar

ORDER BY ... LIMIT 1 tenglardan faqat bittasini qaytaradi. Ikki shaharda buyurtmalar soni bir xil bo'lsa, ikkinchisi yo'qoladi:

Noto'g'riSELECT c.city, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.city
ORDER BY order_count DESC
LIMIT 1

Yana bir xato: customers ni o'zini shahar bo'yicha sanash. Namunada Toshkentda ikki mijoz bor, lekin ular jami 2 ta buyurtma bergan. Samarqanddagi bitta Malika esa 3 ta. Shuning uchun hisob orders dan boshlanadi. Buyurtmalar summasi ham bu yerda kerak emas, faqat soni.

Boshqa yo'l

RANK() tenglarni bir xil o'ringa qo'yadi, shuning uchun = 1 hamma g'oliblarni qaytaradi:

SELECT city, order_count
FROM (
  SELECT c.city, COUNT(*) AS order_count,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS r
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.city
) t
WHERE r = 1
